baseline_prompt_en: Create a photorealistic science-editorial scene inside a storm-lit mobile genomics clinic built into an alpine seed vault. An unmistakably adult woman derived from the supplied portrait’s oval face, brown eyes, and long dark wavy hair stands at a multispectral tissue scanner. Her body is anatomically coherent and naturally human. She places one normal hand beneath the scanner while an adjacent translucent anatomical projection reveals two interwoven fluorescent cell-line distributions in different colors across the same organs; paired microscope slides and a dual-origin cell lineage diagram reinforce the scientific human-chimera context. Her calm concentration, practical field coat, realistic skin, and complete human silhouette remain clearly readable. Seed drawers, wet rock, cable bundles, and lightning beyond a narrow window add complexity. Frame a three-quarter environmental portrait with the woman and the dual-lineage projection equally legible, using cool laboratory light, brief white storm flashes, and restrained documentary color.
